fusions.name: Snaring Sheet
fusions.desc: Casts a mesh of shadow that deals 11 damage to the first enemy it meets and has a 50% chance to leave it [Pinned] for 2 seconds. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Fluttering Mesh
fusions.desc: A beat of wings that deals 3 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles, each with a 35% chance to be left [Slowed] for 4 seconds. Your movement speed rises 15% for 3 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Closing Hour
fusions.desc: Holds every creature within 4 tiles in place for 3 seconds. Your movement speed rises 20% for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Pulled Tight
fusions.desc: Every hit you land ties a strand to that enemy, up to 5. Your next critical hit on it spends them all: the strands pull tight and strike it for 34% of your weapon damage per strand (170% at full). Unfed, a strand fades every 4 seconds.
